entities.summary: Leonardo Lavalle Moreno is a former tennis player from Mexico. He reached his highest singles ATP-ranking of world No. 51 on 17 March 1986 and his highest doubles ranking of No. 23 in April 1992. Lavalle represented his native country at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona, where he was defeated in the quarterfinals by the eventual runner-up Jordi Arrese from Spain. The left-hander won one career title in singles in Tel Aviv in 1991. Leonardo Lavalle was a athletes & competitors from Mexico City (b. 1967-07-14, Mexico City). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
